lang.name: English
lang.label: Language
connect.title: Connect to your Dahlia
connect.intro: The app looks for Dahlia servers in your network. You can also type the address.
connect.none_found: No server found. Type the address below.
pair.check_where: Compare it with the fingerprint on the server's monitor or in the dashboard under Addresses. Only connect if both are the same.
pair.code_hint: Open the dashboard in a browser, for example from the bookmark on your phone, tap the phone icon at the top and create a pairing code.
login.title: Sign in
login.code: Code from the authenticator app or recovery code
login.save: Save password and sign in automatically
update.title: Updating Dahlia
update.why: The server runs Dahlia {server}, this app is {app}. App and server always have the same version, so the app now installs {server}.
update.checking: Looking for the app for Dahlia {version} …
update.installing: Installing, the app starts again by itself …
update.manual: This copy of the app cannot update itself. Install Dahlia {version} for this computer from the release page.
server_update.title: Server update
server_update.done: The server is up to date.
server_update.failed: The update failed. Details are in the dashboard under Updates.
server_update.then_app: When the server is done, the app updates itself to the same version.
home.all_ok: All is well. Dahlia is in bloom.
home.attention: {n} things need attention, see Health in the dashboard.
error.not_dahlia: No Dahlia server runs at this address.
error.changed: The server answers with a different certificate, for example after a reinstall. Pair again, easiest with a pairing code from the dashboard on your phone.
error.code: Not a valid pairing code. Create a new one in the dashboard.
error.proof: The code does not belong to this server. Do not connect if you do not know the address.
error.update_no_manifest: There is no app for Dahlia {version} yet. Update the server or try again later.
error.update_signature: The update list is not signed by Dahlia. Nothing was installed.
error.update_offline: The update could not be downloaded. Is this computer online?
error.update_checksum: The download does not match the signed checksum. Nothing was installed.
error.update_platform: There is no app for this system in Dahlia {version}.
update.server_too_old: The server runs a Dahlia version from before the app. Update the server in the dashboard (on your phone or in a browser), then the app connects.
